_about: What each ARC, husk, probe and courier drops, researched 2026-11-08 from the wiki's per-ARC pages and MetaForge. `sure` drops are on the ARC's own page (not flagged) or backed by a second source. No source publishes drop rates. `arc` links to arcs.json; `marker` to a map marker type. Check in game and edit here.

sources.rev: API fetched 2026-11-08; per-ARC updated_at recorded in notes

arcs.name: Wasp
arcs.notes: Flying combat drone. Destroy, then scavenge the chassis. XP: destroy +100, scavenge +200. MetaForge record updated 2025-11-04.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Synthetic Resin, ARC Thermo Lining, Simple Gun Parts.

arcs.name: Hornet
arcs.notes: Flying combat drone (stun rounds). XP: destroy +150, scavenge +250. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Performance Steel, ARC Synthetic Resin.

arcs.notes: Flying flamethrower drone. XP: destroy +150, scavenge +250. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.

arcs.name: Snitch
arcs.notes: Recon drone that loudly calls ARC reinforcements; since 1.42.0 it can call a Rocketeer or a Firefly+Hornet pair. Kill it fast. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Thermo Lining.

arcs.name: Spotter
arcs.notes: Recon drone paired with a Bombardier; reveals Raiders for its mortar. A destroyed pair respawns; they fly away when the Bombardier dies. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Synthetic Resin, ARC Thermo Lining, Sensors.

arcs.name: Rocketeer
arcs.notes: Large flying drone. Chassis (+600 XP) and each thruster (+500 XP) are scavenged separately. Patch 1.33.0: drops Launcher Ammo instead of Heavy Ammo. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-28.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: Electrical Components.

arcs.name: Vaporizer
arcs.notes: Large flying drone with energy shield. Chassis +600 XP, each thruster +500 XP. Added 1.22.0. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Circuitry.

arcs.name: ARC Turbine
arcs.notes: Large hover drone; descends in groups of three around 16-12 minutes remaining and lays a minefield. Core +700 XP, each shell +200 XP. Patch 2.2.0 removed Turbine spawns from standard sessions and most minor map conditions; none during ARC Frigate. Since 1.36.0 Turbine parts no longer drop from Couriers. MetaForge record updated 2026-09-30.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Coolant, ARC Motion Core, ARC Synthetic Resin, ARC Thermo Lining.

arcs.name: Pop
arcs.notes: Rolling explosive ball. Scavenge ring +100 XP. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Coolant.

arcs.name: Fireball
arcs.notes: Rolling flamethrower ball. Scavenge core +200 XP. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Coolant, ARC Thermo Lining.

arcs.name: Comet
arcs.notes: Rolling self-destruct ball. Wiki: the Comet Igniter only comes from a Comet that did not blow itself up. Removed from standard Dam Battlegrounds sessions in 1.26.0. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: MetaForge lists, wiki does not: Electrical Components.

arcs.name: ARC Surveyor
arcs.notes: Unarmed armored rolling ball that flees fast. 'Rollbot' redirects to ARC Surveyor on the wiki and MetaForge's id for it is 'rollbot', so they are the same ARC. Core +300 XP, each shell +100 XP. MetaForge record updated 2026-09-30.
arcs.disputes: MetaForge lists, wiki does not: Vita Spray Blueprint, Barricade Kit Blueprint, Extended Medium Mag III Blueprint, Heavy Gun Parts Blueprint, Extended Barrel III Blueprint, Padded Stock Blueprint, Vita Shot Blueprint. Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Coolant, ARC Performance Steel, Mechanical Components.

arcs.name: Tick
arcs.notes: Small leaping hexapod that latches on. Scavenge +100 XP. MetaForge record updated 2025-10-08.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Flex Rubber, ARC Powercell, ARC Thermo Lining.

arcs.name: Shredder
arcs.notes: Ground hover drone, close-quarters shrapnel. No longer Stella Montis only. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Data Module, ARC Synthetic Resin, ARC Thermo Lining, Mechanical Components.

arcs.name: Skulker
arcs.notes: Small hover drone with a heavy-ammo tail turret; the Skulker Targeter is in the stinger/turret. Added 2.0; wiki page is a stub. MetaForge record updated 2026-09-30.
arcs.disputes: MetaForge has this ARC but its loot list is empty.

arcs.name: Turret
arcs.notes: Stationary indoor turret. Has no unique part. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Powercell, ARC Synthetic Resin, ARC Thermo Lining.

arcs.name: Sentinel
arcs.notes: Long-range sniper turret on rooftops/ledges; weak point is the rear canister. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Flex Rubber, Medium Gun Parts, Simple Gun Parts.

arcs.name: Hydra
arcs.notes: Multi-turret ARC (found in the Frigate Cargo Hold). Wiki splits loot: main debris = Light Ammo, ARC Powercell, ARC Alloy; turret debris = Light Ammo, ARC Alloy. No unique part. Added 2.0; wiki page is a stub. MetaForge record updated 2026-09-23.
arcs.disputes: MetaForge has this ARC but its loot list is empty.

arcs.disputes: Wiki internal: ARC overview lists Heavy Gun Parts but the Bastion page does not. Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Conductive Coupler, ARC Flex Rubber, ARC Performance Steel.

arcs.name: Bombardier
arcs.notes: Mortar hexapod paired with Spotters. Core, shell and legs scavenged separately (+300 XP each). MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: MetaForge lists, wiki does not: Medium Gun Parts. Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Flex Rubber, ARC Motion Core, Heavy Gun Parts.

arcs.name: Leaper
arcs.notes: Agile quadruped with leap and shockwave. It was called Bison until the Server Slam test; the wiki redirects Bison to Leaper and MetaForge's id is 'bison'. Eye +600 XP, each leg +500 XP. MetaForge record updated 2025-11-04.
arcs.disputes: MetaForge lists, wiki does not: ARC Powercell, ARC Circuitry.

arcs.name: Bully

drops.note: only in ARC overview 'Notable drops', not on the ARC's own page

arcs.notes: Dog-like quadruped with shotgun and cluster bombs. Head/body +500 XP, each leg +200 XP. Added 2.0; wiki page is a stub and its loot list is marked 'More...'. MetaForge record updated 2026-09-30.

arcs.name: Queen
arcs.notes: Giant hexapod (map condition; also guards the Harvester). Main debris (core) pool has everything listed; small debris lacks Advanced Electrical Components, Advanced Mechanical Components, ARC Flex Rubber and Complex Gun Parts. Core +1000 XP, each leg +500 XP. MetaForge record updated 2025-12-09.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: Complex Gun Parts.

arcs.name: Matriarch
arcs.notes: Giant hexapod (Matriarch map condition only); summons ARC and has an energy shield. Main debris has everything listed; small debris lacks Advanced Electrical Components, Advanced Mechanical Components, ARC Insulated Coupler and Complex Gun Parts. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: MetaForge lists, wiki does not: Aphelion Blueprint. Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Coolant, ARC Insulated Coupler, Advanced Electrical Components, Advanced Mechanical Components, Complex Gun Parts.

arcs.notes: Frigate transport drone; climb on and disrupt it with the Raider Tool to ride it to the ARC Frigate. 0 XP. Added 2.0. Not in MetaForge.

arcs.notes: ARC Operation map condition. Board it, destroy the Power Cores, undo 4 latches and breach 2 circular latches to drop the Frigate Cargo (primary loot). Interior containers hold mid-tier ARC loot with a small chance of Amplification Modules, Frigate Inductors and ARC Data. The Cargo has a much higher frequency of Frigate Diagnostic Nodes and Amplification Modules. Frigate Cannon drops are '?' on the wiki. Item names here come only from the ARC overview; the Frigate page names no exact item list. MetaForge record updated 2026-09-30.
arcs.disputes: MetaForge has this ARC but its loot list is empty.

arcs.name: Baron Husk
arcs.notes: Static husk; must be breached; infobox says trapped. +500 XP. Wiki: drops confirmed, ranges not.

arcs.name: Deforester Husk
arcs.notes: Blue Gate puzzle husk (3 sites). Needs two ARC Powercells per husk inserted to open, with timed fire hazards; infobox breach=Yes, trapped. Infobox search XP 0, overview says +200. Wiki: drops confirmed, ranges not, there may be other items.

arcs.name: ARC Probe
arcs.notes: Lands to collect samples, then leaves. Breaching makes it beep and signal nearby ARC (calls ARC); trapped after a failed breach. A full probe opens 3 panels; a crashed probe opens only 1. +700 XP.
arcs.disputes: No MetaForge record; wiki is the only source.

arcs.name: ARC Courier
arcs.notes: Breachable; loot is mostly ARC parts, including damaged parts. +700 XP. Since 1.36.0 no Turbine parts. Wiki: drops confirmed, ranges and chances not. ARC Flex Rubber, ARC Performance Steel, ARC Synthetic Resin, Damaged ARC Powercell, Degraded ARC Rubber, Dried-Out ARC Resin and Impure ARC Coolant are commented out of the wiki table and excluded here.
arcs.disputes: No MetaForge record; wiki is the only source.

arcs.name: ARC Assessor
arcs.notes: Comes down during the Close Scrutiny ARC Operation. Loot is in breachable containers around it; breaching calls down a squadron of ARC. +200 XP. Added 1.22.0. MetaForge record updated 2026-06-29.
arcs.disputes: Wiki page lists, MetaForge does not: ARC Coolant, ARC Flex Rubber, ARC Motion Core, ARC Performance Steel, ARC Synthetic Resin, ARC Thermo Lining, Advanced ARC Powercell, Advanced Electrical Components, Dolabra Blueprint. Patch 2.3.0: the Dolabra blueprint can now drop in any major map condition, so it is no longer Assessor-specific; the wiki still describes a 'small chance' here.

arcs.name: Harvester
arcs.notes: Map-condition structure guarded by a Queen. Breachable containers on the upper level (fusion cores, ARC materials); insert 3 fusion cores and shoot 12 yellow targets to open the centre containers. Hazards: fire discharge, and after insertion a Queen-driven electrical surge. Not in MetaForge.
arcs.disputes: No MetaForge record; wiki is the only source. Wiki says the puzzle containers guarantee 1-3 Equalizer or Jupiter blueprints. Patch 2.3.0 lets Equalizer and Jupiter drop in any major map condition and slightly lowered that pool's drop chance; the patch does not say whether the Harvester guarantee still holds.
